subject: GGUF deferred until after full selected-recipe training run
body: Patrick clarified the GGUF/KoboldCpp note was future-reference only. Correction: do NOT export a GGUF from step28, step32, or any other bounded development checkpoint. Development checkpoints exist only to select/qualify optimizer/runtime/cadence and stop rules. First select the surviving training recipe, then complete the full intended training run on the bound corpus under that recipe, then run the post-train development/qualification checks. Only after that full training run is complete should Lane A build merged-HF/GGUF artifacts. Lane B independent KoboldCpp verification begins only after that immutable full-run GGUF handoff. All previous KoboldCpp role-separation requirements remain, but the trigger moves from admitted development checkpoint to completed full training run.
